Input image 1 is the approved Milo canonical and is the sole identity authority. Create exactly ONE isolated Milo on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. IDENTITY LOCK: A small handmade needle-felt mouse with warm neutral-grey wool, cream muzzle and a modest softly rounded cream belly patch that follows his compact torso without a protruding pot belly, charcoal inner ears, moss-green eyes, muted burnt-orange tail, short sturdy legs and two large rounded ears. Keep both ears visible where the registered crop permits. No mane, crest, top-hair tuft or elongated/slim body. Milo never shows visible teeth, including in smiles, speech or gnawing; use a soft felt lip and mouth crease against the knot. Keep exactly the canonical face/head proportions, eye size/spacing, eye color, muzzle, nose, ears, felt material density and intrinsic colors. Preserve the same character’s body volume, head-to-body proportions and limb anatomy through this pose. Fine handmade needle-felt surface, soft natural edges and whiskers; no open yarn loops.
Lighting: soft neutral fill that preserves canonical pigment with a restrained warm light from upper left. No painted ground, no opaque backdrop, no environment, no cast shadow baked into the alpha, no props, no text, no other animal. Keep all extremities and ears/mane/tail within generous transparent margins. Closed mouth; Milo never has visible teeth. This is an isolated pose study for review, not an approved scene image.

preliminary_review.scope: Native rendered pose compared against canonical; ears/mane, eye/muzzle design, closed toothless Milo mouth, single tail, visible limb separation checked. Pose-box/standing equivalence and complete owner review remain pending.
